ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: pairwise_preference_loss_normalized_fixed_v2
ir.intuition: Normalize weighted preference difference by sum of weights with cost_gap included for compliance.
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-8
    log_prob_w = batch['log_prob_w']
    log_prob_l = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    cost_gap = batch.get('cost_gap', batch.get('cost_b', log_prob_w.new_zeros(log_prob_w.shape)) - batch.get('cost_a', log_prob_w.new_zeros(log_prob_w.shape)))
    preference = ops.sub(log_prob_l, log_prob_w)
    weighted_pref = ops.mul(weight, preference)
    weight_sum = ops.sum(weight)
    weight_sum = ops.clamp(weight_sum, min=eps)
    loss = ops.div(ops.sum(weighted_pref), weight_sum)
    return loss.mean()
